Dialog.ResetContent: Are you sure you want to reset your flavor configuration to defaults? This cannot be undone.
Dialog.ResetFoundryContent: Restore this client back to stock Foundry? This will turn off the current Customize Foundry profile and remove this module's applied colors, layout, visibility, and pause media overrides.
Dialog.ResetFoundryStockContent:
This saves a clean Foundry Shell baseline immediately.

The Foundry Shell master switch and area switches stay on, while visual categories are reset to neutral stock values so the tabletop looks original. As you edit a color, layout, window, icon, pause, or CSS control, the needed category is enabled again and applies live. Chat styling, rolls, cards, presets, favorites, and messages are not changed.
Dialog.FactoryResetContent:
This permanently clears Your Flavor customizations for this world.

Chat styling, rolls, cards, Foundry shell customization, icon groups, individual icon overrides, hidden icons, icon class swaps, colors, favorites, imports, drafts, shared profiles, legacy config, and applied DOM changes will return to stock defaults.

Scenes, actors, items, chat messages, playlists, and other modules are not deleted.

Configuration.BehaviorHint: Real module settings, grouped by who they affect.
Configuration.CoreHint: Turn the module and its game-wide interface profile on or off.
Configuration.CustomCssHint: Raw CSS applies on top of the Foundry Shell profile and can break the interface. Use with caution.
Configuration.FoundryMasterHint: Applies the working Foundry Shell profile. This also stages the existing world feature gate.
Configuration.ModuleEnabledHint: Stops styling new chat messages without deleting saved configuration. Foundry Shell has its own separate feature gate.
Configuration.ModulesHint: These are apply gates. Detailed editing stays in Foundry Shell or Icons.
Configuration.OpenHint: Open an area to refine it
Configuration.PlayerHint: Decide whether players can make or use their own chat presentation.
Configuration.ShareFoundryHint: When off, only the GM sees the saved Foundry Shell profile.

Diagnostics.ContrastCoverage: Up to five Chat and five Foundry warning rows.
Diagnostics.CoverageHint: Status and information only — no automated repair pass
Diagnostics.EmergencyResetHint: Run the existing Emergency Reset. It restores Foundry customization to stock, saves that reset, and asks for confirmation.
Diagnostics.FactoryResetClears: Permanently clears Your Flavor settings, drafts, profiles, favorites, and module user flags across this world.
Diagnostics.FactoryResetKicker: Last resort · destructive to Your Flavor configuration
Diagnostics.FactoryResetPreserves: Scenes, actors, items, chat messages, playlists, and data owned by other modules are not deleted. A confirmation dialog appears before reset.
Diagnostics.FactoryResetScope: World settings, this client’s settings, shared Foundry customization, per-user profiles, actor overrides, icon changes, and applied runtime styling return to defaults.
Diagnostics.FallbackCoverage: Up to five recent unsupported-message fallbacks.
Diagnostics.FooterStatus: Diagnostics are read-only until you choose an action
Diagnostics.HealthHint: Review the live checks, try a limited stop, then use a reset only when its scope matches the problem.
Diagnostics.IconCoverage: 8 supported groups, matched entries, and target counts.
Diagnostics.LeastDisruptive: Start with the least disruptive option
Diagnostics.LiveDetailHint: Open a section to inspect the current rows and target matches.
Diagnostics.SelectorCoverage: 11 supported interface areas and each configured selector.
Diagnostics.SnapshotHint: Real fields already collected by Diagnostics
Diagnostics.StopNewChatStylingHint: Turn off the existing Enable Module world setting. Current code gates new chat-message styling; saved configuration is kept and Foundry Shell remains separate.
Diagnostics.Sub: Understand what Your Flavor sees before changing anything.
Diagnostics.Title: Diagnostics
Diagnostics.TrustNote: Contrast uses the current working draft. Selector and icon checks inspect the current DOM. Safe fallbacks are remembered only for this session.
